intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Bethesda for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events, 1 of them free. The magic runs from November 20 (Photos with Santa at Westfield Montgomery) through December 24 (the Westfield Santa photos), with Bethesda's Winter Wonderland (December 5), Winter's Eve at Glen Echo Park (December 5) and Santa Cares (December 6) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Bethesda

  • 6 Christmas events for kids in Bethesda
  • 1 free event: Winter's Eve at Glen Echo Park (shows and portraits extra)
  • Meet Santa: Bethesda's Winter Wonderland (December 5), Westfield Montgomery photos (November 20 to December 24), Brunch with Santa and Santa Cares (December 6), Santa pictures at The Collection at Chevy Chase
  • Crafts and shows: Winter's Eve at Glen Echo Park (December 5)
  • Season: November 20 to December 24

Planning a bigger day out? Bethesda families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Washington, DC, which covers the National Christmas Tree, ZooLights and the Wharf boat parade.

name: Bethesda
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Bethesda, MD for 2026: Winter Wonderland with Santa, Winter's Eve at Glen Echo Park and Westfield Santa visits.
lede: Bethesda keeps its Christmas close to home with a downtown Winter Wonderland, a holiday open house at Glen Echo Park and Santa visits at Westfield Montgomery.
celebrates: Bethesda Urban Partnership closes Norfolk and Cordell Avenues in the Woodmont Triangle for Bethesda's Winter Wonderland, a Saturday afternoon with Santa Claus, live ice sculpting, a student choral concert, face painting and craft tables hosted by local arts groups. A short drive away, Glen Echo Park opens its studios and galleries for Winter's Eve, with children's crafts, live music and two ticketed children's theater shows. Westfield Montgomery runs the mall Santa season, including Photos with Santa, a Brunch with Santa and a sensory friendly Santa Cares morning, and The Collection at Chevy Chase offers pictures with Santa too.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap for Bethesda's holiday events. The Winter Wonderland page still carries one line from last year, saying the ice sculpting demo took place on Saturday, December 6, 2025 from noon to 1:30 pm on Norfolk Avenue near St. Elmo Avenue, which tells us the festival also ran in the first week of December in 2025. This page leans on each host's 2026 listing.
facts: Glen Echo Park holds open studios and galleries during Winter's Eve, and holiday arts and crafts for children run in classrooms of its Arcade Building. The Washington Conservatory of Music's Suzuki Violins carol through the Arcade Building from 4:45 pm. Adventure Theatre's Frosty the Snowman and the Puppet Co.'s 38th annual Nutcracker are staged that same day, and the park says most of the activities are free.
trains: We did not find a holiday train inside Bethesda itself. The closest ride is at the National Capital Trolley Museum in Colesville, where Holly TrolleyFest runs on weekends from November 28 with Santa and Mrs. Claus aboard historic streetcars. Admission there is $15 per person, children 2 and under are free, and advance tickets are required. See our Silver Spring page for the full details of that ride.

kidfact: At Bethesda's Winter Wonderland, kids can watch an ice sculptor turn a big block of ice into a holiday shape right on the street.
faq: Bethesda Urban Partnership hosts Bethesda's Winter Wonderland on Norfolk and Cordell Avenues each December, with Santa, ice sculpting and live music. Glen Echo Park and Westfield Montgomery add craft, theater and Santa events nearby.
Where can kids meet Santa in Bethesda?
At Bethesda's Winter Wonderland from 2 to 4 pm on Saturday, December 5, at Westfield Montgomery for photos, a brunch and a sensory friendly morning, and at The Collection at Chevy Chase.
Is Winter's Eve at Glen Echo Park free?
Most activities are free, according to the park. Photoworks portraits cost $35 and the Frosty the Snowman and Nutcracker shows are ticketed.
Is there a Santa train near Bethesda?
The closest is Holly TrolleyFest at the National Capital Trolley Museum in Colesville, which runs on weekends from November 28.
